extends SmokeTestBase


func test_derive_seed_stable_and_distinct() -> void:
	var base: int = RngService.derive_seed(1, "waves")
	ok(base == RngService.derive_seed(1, "waves"), "same inputs give same stream seed")
	ok(base != RngService.derive_seed(1, "combat"), "different streams differ")
	ok(base != RngService.derive_seed(2, "waves"), "different session seeds differ")


func test_stream_sequence_is_deterministic() -> void:
	var saved_seed := Session.seed_value
	Session.seed_value = 7
	RngService.reset()
	var first := _sample_wave_stream()
	RngService.reset()
	var second := _sample_wave_stream()
	ok(first == second, "same seed reproduces identical sequence")
	ok(first.size() == 8, "sample complete")
	Session.seed_value = saved_seed
	RngService.reset()


func test_different_seeds_diverge() -> void:
	var saved_seed := Session.seed_value
	Session.seed_value = 7
	RngService.reset()
	var a := _sample_wave_stream()
	Session.seed_value = 8
	RngService.reset()
	var b := _sample_wave_stream()
	ok(a != b, "seed change changes sequence")
	Session.seed_value = saved_seed
	RngService.reset()


func test_named_streams_diverge() -> void:
	var saved_seed := Session.seed_value
	Session.seed_value = 3
	RngService.reset()
	ok(RngService.stream("a").randi() != RngService.stream("b").randi(),
		"distinct named streams produce distinct values")
	Session.seed_value = saved_seed
	RngService.reset()


func _sample_wave_stream() -> Array:
	var rng := RngService.stream("waves")
	var out: Array = []
	for i in 8:
		out.append(rng.randi())
	return out

extends SmokeTestBase


func test_defaults_after_reset() -> void:
	Session.reset()
	ok(Session.mode == Session.Mode.NORMAL, "default mode NORMAL")
	ok(Session.seed_value == Session.DEFAULT_SEED, "default seed 1")
	ok(Session.listen_port == Session.DEFAULT_PORT, "default port 7777")


func test_empty_args_is_normal_mode() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray()) == OK, "empty args OK")
	ok(Session.mode == Session.Mode.NORMAL, "mode NORMAL")


func test_host_mode() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--host"])) == OK, "host parses")
	ok(Session.mode == Session.Mode.HOST, "mode HOST")


func test_client_mode_with_address() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--connect=127.0.0.1"])) == OK, "connect parses")
	ok(Session.mode == Session.Mode.CLIENT, "mode CLIENT")
	ok(Session.connect_address == "127.0.0.1", "address stored")
	ok(Session.listen_port == Session.DEFAULT_PORT, "port default")


func test_client_address_with_port() -> void:
	Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--connect=10.0.0.7:9999"]))
	ok(Session.connect_address == "10.0.0.7", "address split from port")
	ok(Session.listen_port == 9999, "port taken from address")


func test_port_flag() -> void:
	Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--port=1234"]))
	ok(Session.listen_port == 1234, "--port applied")


func test_seed_flag() -> void:
	Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--seed=42"]))
	ok(Session.seed_value == 42, "--seed applied")


func test_seed_must_be_integer() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--seed=abc"])) != OK, "non-int seed rejected")


func test_unknown_arg_rejected() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--frobnicate"])) != OK, "unknown arg rejected")


func test_exclusive_modes_rejected() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--host", "--connect=x"])) != OK, "host+client rejected")
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--test", "--host"])) != OK, "test+host rejected")
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--benchmark=noop", "--seed=2", "--test"])) != OK, "benchmark+test rejected")


func test_benchmark_mode() -> void:
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--benchmark=noop"])) == OK, "benchmark parses")
	ok(Session.mode == Session.Mode.BENCHMARK, "mode BENCHMARK")
	ok(Session.benchmark_name == "noop", "benchmark name stored")
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--benchmark="])) != OK, "empty benchmark name rejected")


func test_log_categories() -> void:
	Session.reset()
	ok(Session.category_enabled("COMBAT"), "all categories on by default")
	ok(Session.apply(PackedStringArray(["--log-cats=crowd,perf"])) == OK, "log-cats parse")
	ok(not Session.category_enabled("COMBAT"), "unlisted category filtered out")
	ok(Session.category_enabled("CROWD"), "listed category enabled")


func test_local_operation_preset() -> void:
	Session.reset()
	Session.enable_local_operation()
	ok(Session.mode == Session.Mode.HOST, "local operation promotes to authoritative host")
	ok(Session.operation_mode, "local operation enables authored operation")
	ok(Session.crowd_sim, "local operation uses real CrowdSim")
	ok(not Session.ladder_print, "local operation is not a stress ladder")
	Session.reset()
